notes:
NEXORA 1.0.35

**Added**

- **Catalog artwork prefetch for non-Steam games** — a keyless artwork step fetches official CDN covers for Genshin Impact, Honkai: Star Rail, League of Legends, Minecraft, Roblox, Fortnite, Legends of Runeterra and Zenless Zone Zero before any key-gated source is tried.
- **New toast/note strings** — partial "apply recommended" results, unverified apply/restore notices and per-user policy notes, with Indonesian translations.
- **Battery: honest UX (capability probe)** — the Battery panel now probes what the device actually supports before showing a control: charge-limit firmware that is not detected swaps the doomed toggle for a clearly-labeled software reminder plus a BIOS/OEM hint, unsupported plan features are hidden, needs-admin features stay visible but disabled with the reason, health shows a caveat when design capacity is not trustworthy, and identical error toasts no longer stack.

**Changed**

- **"Apply recommended" distinguishes admin-skipped tweaks from failures** and reports an exact "applied N of M, K need administrator rights" result instead of a generic failure.
- **Restoring the USB selective-suspend tweak now writes the Windows stock value back**, so the status engine — and its card switch — correctly reports "not applied" after a restore.
- **Advanced-tweak checks read registry DWORD values as numbers** — a stock DWORD previously read back garbled as UTF-16, making stock values look "not applied".

**Fixed**

- **Game Library "Discover" tab uses one card layout** — poster-only cards were merged into the shared banner + metadata structure, so every card in the grid is uniform.
- **Non-Steam covers no longer fall back to initials** — dead artwork URLs replaced with verified live official CDN art, and the image CSP allowlist covers the new hosts.
- **The sidebar no longer clips at the window's left edge** — labels and menu icons render fully; the section-entrance animation no longer slides content off-screen.
- **Settings slider tracks fill only up to the thumb** — the accent progress fill on every range slider (background opacity/overlay/blur, profile sliders, overlay panel) now follows the thumb position on drag instead of reading as a solid full-width accent bar.
